newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes firm as TEM rates rise.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes firm as TEM rates rise.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed firmer at 476.75/477.75 bolivars per dollar as yields on benchmark six month TEMs rose 105 basis points to 17.54 percent at the Central Bank's regular Wednesday auction, traders said.
The unit closed Tuesday at 477.25/477.75 per dollar.
Traders said dollars were freely available -- even though the Central Bank halted dollar sales by the late afternoon.
The steady dollar flow "was largely due to foreign investors buying bolivars, cashing in on the rise in TEM yields," said one broker.
